tekening.subHint: Configure paper and scale in the toolbar below. Drop PDF/JPG/SVG on the sheet for an overlay.
tekening.moveHint: Click Move and then the object (or select it first), move the mouse and click to place it. Arrow keys = 1 m (Shift = 5 m).
tekening.copyHint: Duplicate next to the selected object (Ctrl+D)
tekening.rotateHint: Asks for the angle in degrees (negative = anticlockwise).
tekening.cadTrimHint: First click a reference line, then the part of another line that must GO (cut at the intersection).
tekening.cadExtendHint: First click a reference line, then the end of the line that must be extended.
tekening.cadMirrorHint: First select a line, then click two points on the map to set the mirror axis.
tekening.cadOffsetHint: Click a line, enter the distance in m, then click on the side where the parallel copy should go.
tekening.exportDwgHint: Export the drawing including GIS layers (buildings, parcels) to DWG/DXF. Choose RD or local coordinates; choose .dwg or .dxf in the save dialog.
tekening.requestQuotesHint: Opens a dialog with the nearest CPT contractors and a pre-filled quote request in your mail client

ifc.openHint: Open an IFC4x3 STEP or IfcX JSON file to inspect its structure.
ifc.noFiles: No IFC files generated in this session yet
ifc.noneHint: Click 'Generate IFC4x3' or 'Generate IfcX' in the ribbon to produce an IFC file from the active project.
ifc.autoHint: Experimental IFCX snapshots update live. IFC4x3 export is disabled.
ifc.paneNoCpt: No CPTs in this project — add a CPT first.

report.sectionsHint: Choose which parts to include in the report.
report.emptyHint: Click 'Generate PDF' to build a report
report.openCptHint: Open a GEF or BRO-XML file to generate a report.

section.mapHint: Page with all CPT locations on a map
section.sbtHint: Separate page with the 9 soil zones

report.openInNewWindow: Open the PDF in the system viewer

model3d.defaultCriterion: default; set it in a foundation advice
model3d.empty: Add CPTs to build the soil model.
model3d.noWebgl: 3D view is not available on this system (no WebGL).

scaleCptColumnsHint: After Fit, also widen the columns; scroll horizontally for the other CPTs.
